title: Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic

abstractEnglish: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral projective variety X over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, with $`\dim X=n\ge3`$. We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at the geometric generic tuple of r points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$. The same conclusion holds in dimension two. This establishes the positive-characteristic form of the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion at geometric generic tuples.
titleEn: Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic
titleZh: 正特征情形下的极大多点Seshadri常数

details.overview: 稿件研究代数闭正特征域上光滑整射影簇X（维数n≥3）上丰沛线丛L的多点Seshadri常数。摘要表示，作者证明存在阈值r₀，使得当r≥r₀时，在r个点的几何一般元组处的普通多点Seshadri常数等于体积上界(L^n/r)^{1/n}；二维情形同样成立。作者声称由此在几何一般元组处建立了正特征形式的定性Nagata–Biran–Szemberg断言。该结果属于正特征代数几何研究；当前收录摘要未给出证明细节。
keyPoints: 研究对象为正特征光滑射影簇上丰沛线丛的多点Seshadri常数。
作者声称点数超过阈值r₀时该常数等于体积上界(L^n/r)^{1/n}。
结论在几何一般元组处成立，二维情形同样适用。
